preconditions.expression: len(t) == n and 1 <= n <= 10000 and all('a' <= c <= 'z' for c in t)
preconditions.description: The initial input string t has length n between 1 and 10000, consisting only of lowercase Latin letters.
The hidden sequence of swaps is fixed for the test case and applies consistently to any query string of length n.

postconditions.expression: len(output_lines) <= 4 and output_lines[-1].startswith('! ') and len(output_lines[-1].split(' ', 1)[1]) == n
postconditions.description: The program outputs at most 3 query lines (starting with '?') followed by exactly one answer line starting with '!' containing a string of length n.

postconditions.expression: all(line.startswith('? ') and len(line.split(' ', 1)[1]) == n for line in output_lines[:-1])
postconditions.description: Every query line (if any) starts with '? ' followed by a string of exactly n lowercase Latin letters.
The string s provided in the final answer, when the hidden sequence of swaps is applied to it, results in the input string t.
